title: Every summand of an object with a left dual has a left dual
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in a Karoubian additive monoidal category every direct summand of an object admitting a left dual again admits a left dual (statement lines 4216-4220). The proof is a complete argument: the adjunction identifies the endomorphism algebra of the object with the algebra of its dual and shows that the identification reverses composition (proof lines 4223-4238); the idempotents coming from a direct sum decomposition are transported to the dual, where Karoubian-ness splits them, and the adjunction restricts to the pieces (proof lines 4238-4244); the resulting identifications give the required duals of the summands (proof lines 4244-4247). The non-formal content is the transport of idempotents through the algebra anti-isomorphism. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
